title: Induced EMF magnitude
description: Essential: The response must correctly state the induced electromotive force as E = BLv.

title: Power of pulling force
description: Essential: The response must correctly derive and state the power as P = (B²L²v²)/R.

title: Joule heat in side ab
description: Essential: The response must correctly calculate the Joule heat generated in side ab as Q = (B²L³v)/(4R).

title: Force balance reasoning
description: Important: The solution must apply Newton's first law, equating the pulling force to the Ampere force on side ad for constant velocity.

title: Current and resistance analysis
description: Important: The solution must correctly use Ohm's law to find the current and identify the resistance of side ab as R/4.

title: Time interval identification
description: Important: The solution must correctly identify the relevant time interval as t = L/v for the motion described.

title: Incorrect motional EMF formula
description: Pitfall: Using an incorrect formula for motional EMF, such as E = Bv or E = BL, should be penalized.

title: Sign or direction error
description: Pitfall: Introducing an incorrect sign for the induced EMF or current direction, though the magnitude is often the focus, is a common conceptual error.

title: Unit consistency check
description: Optional: A check for dimensional or unit consistency in the final expressions demonstrates deeper understanding.
